title: Bangladesh Bank, Guideline on Sustainability and Climate-related Financial Disclosure for Banks and Finance Companies (SFD Circular No. 06 of 2023)
citation: Bangladesh Bank SFD Circular No. 06, 26 December 2023, issued under s. 45 Bank Companies Act 1991 and s. 41(2) Finance Company Act 2023
evidence: Circular, para 7: "This circular will come into force with immediate effect." Circular date: 26 December 2023. PDF (16 pages) opened with headless Chromium on 2026-11-02.
notes: Link only: row BD-BB-ADOPTED is permission requested (the bb.org.bd footer is a disclaimer only; no reuse terms). Applies to all scheduled banks and finance companies; based on the IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards incorporating the TCFD recommendations, with semi-annual reporting to the Sustainable Finance Department. English only; no Bangla version of the circular was looked for or found on the circular pages opened. Related: bd-bb-sfd-01-2025.

title: Bangladesh Bank, Guideline on Climate Risk Management for Banks and Finance Companies (SFD Circular No. 01 of 2025)
citation: Bangladesh Bank SFD Circular No. 01, 6 November 2025, issued under s. 45 Bank Companies Act 1991 and s. 41(2) Finance Company Act 2023
evidence: Circular, para 6: "This circular will come into force with immediate effect." Circular date: 06 November 2025. PDF opened with headless Chromium on 2026-11-02.
notes: Link only: row BD-BB-ADOPTED is permission requested (disclaimer only; no reuse terms). Climate risk management guideline for banks and finance companies, filed under F6 as the other supervisory climate-risk guidelines are (CA OSFI B-15, HK GS-1). The URL was found by pattern from the SFD 06 URL, not from a circular list page (the list page loads its rows by script); the PDF answered 200 application/pdf. English only.

title: BSEC Corporate Governance Code, 2018 (Notification No. BSEC/CMRRCD/2006-158/207/Admin/80)
citation: BSEC Notification of 3 June 2018, Bangladesh Gazette Extraordinary of 10 June 2018, under s. 2CC Securities and Exchange Ordinance 1969
evidence: Notification "Dated : 3 June 2018"; the text has no commencement clause, so the issue date is used. Its last line: "This Notification shall be complied within 31 December 2018." PDF opened with curl on 2026-11-02 (200 application/pdf 287607 bytes).
notes: Link only: row BD-BSEC-ADOPTED is permission requested (disclaimer only). Narrow ESG content: the annual-report items require management's discussion of "risks and concerns including internal and external risk factors, threat to sustainability and negative impact on environment, if any". Amended by BSEC notifications of 2023-11-28 (https://sec.gov.bd/storage/laws/Notification_28.11.2023.pdf) and 2024-05-26 (female independent director; not ESG-specific); the amendments are not separate entries. No BSEC directive or rule on sustainability reporting or on IFRS S1 and S2 was found on the Act, Rules and Regulations list (https://sec.gov.bd/act-rules-and-regulations, opened 2026-11-02). English only.

title: Bangladesh Environment Conservation Act, 1995 (Act No. 1 of 1995), as amended
evidence: s. 1(2): "সরকার, সরকারী গেজেটে প্রজ্ঞাপন দ্বারা, যে তারিখ নির্ধারণ করিবে সেই তারিখে এই আইন বলবত্ হইবে" (the Government fixes the commencement date by gazette notification). The bdlaws page shows the assent date [১৬ ফেব্রুয়ারি, ১৯৯৫] and no commencement notification, so no official page read states an in-force date. Opened http://bdlaws.minlaw.gov.bd/act-details-791.html on 2026-11-02.
notes: Link only: row BD-BDLAWS-CONSOLIDATED is permission requested (site footer claims copyright for the Legislative and Parliamentary Affairs Division and grants no reuse; the Copyright Act 2023 has no official-text exception), so nothing is stored. Authentic text: Bangla (the page is the Bangla text; ?lang=en returned the same bytes, and no English text of the Act was found on bdlaws). Environment Conservation Rules 1997 were not searched for in this wave. Implemented with the Environment Court Act 2010 (bd-environment-court-act-2010).

evidence: s. 1(2): "ইহা অবিলম্বে কার্যকর হইবে।" (it takes effect immediately). The bdlaws page shows no assent or gazette date, so no official page read states a date. Opened http://bdlaws.minlaw.gov.bd/act-details-1061.html on 2026-11-02.
notes: Link only: row BD-BDLAWS-CONSOLIDATED is permission requested (site footer claims copyright for the Legislative and Parliamentary Affairs Division and grants no reuse; the Copyright Act 2023 has no official-text exception), so nothing is stored. Authentic text: Bangla; no English text found on bdlaws. Sets up environment courts for offences under the Environment Conservation Act 1995 and repeals the Environment Court Act 2000 (s. 24). Companion to bd-eca-1995.

title: Consumer Rights Protection Act, 2009 (Act No. 26 of 2009), s. 44 false advertising (ভোক্তা অধিকার সংরক্ষণ আইন, ২০০৯)
citation: Act No. 26 of 2009; assented 6 April 2009; s. 44
evidence: s. 1(2): "এই আইন অবিলম্বে কার্যকর হইবে।"; the bdlaws page dates the Act [এপ্রিল ৬, ২০০৯]. Opened http://bdlaws.minlaw.gov.bd/act-details-1014.html on 2026-11-02.
notes: Link only: row BD-BDLAWS-CONSOLIDATED is permission requested (site footer claims copyright for the Legislative and Parliamentary Affairs Division and grants no reuse; the Copyright Act 2023 has no official-text exception), so nothing is stored. s. 44 ("কোন ব্যক্তি কোন পণ্য বা সেবা বিক্রয়ের উদ্দেশ্যে অসত্য বা মিথ্যা বিজ্ঞাপন দ্বারা ক্রেতা সাধারণকে প্রতারিত করিলে" ... up to one year in prison, a fine up to 200,000 taka, or both) is a general false-advertising offence; it does not mention environmental claims, and it is the umbrella the brief named, not a green-claims rule. Authentic text: Bangla; no English text found on bdlaws.

title: Forest and Tree Conservation Act, 2026 (Act No. 56 of 2026) (বন ও বৃক্ষ সংরক্ষণ আইন, ২০২৬)
citation: Act No. 56 of 2026; dated 10 April 2026; replaces the Forest and Tree Conservation Ordinance 2026 (Ordinance No. 08 of 2026)
evidence: s. 1(2): "ইহা ৬ জানুয়ারি,২০২৬ তারিখে কার্যকর হইয়াছে বলিয়া গণ্য হইবে।" (deemed in force on 6 January 2026). Opened http://bdlaws.minlaw.gov.bd/act-details-1685.html on 2026-11-02.
notes: Link only: row BD-BDLAWS-CONSOLIDATED is permission requested (site footer claims copyright for the Legislative and Parliamentary Affairs Division and grants no reuse; the Copyright Act 2023 has no official-text exception), so nothing is stored. Added beyond the brief's candidates: the preamble names climate change impacts and biodiversity, and the Act restricts conversion of forest land and felling of listed trees. Authentic text: Bangla; s. 17 lets the Government publish an English text by gazette notice, and none was found on bdlaws. s. 18 repeals the Ordinance (act-1601, shown [রহিত] in the index).
